decisions.rationale: C2-deficiency names one specific complement component deficiency (C2 deficiency) with a single definition, so it is a Specific Disease rather than a class.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 1 (Specific Disease); Examples 6 (C7 deficiency is a Specific Disease)

decisions.rationale: Myasthenia gravis is a single, specific disease with one definition and no further categorization in this context.

'Complement deficiency states' refers to a family of multiple specific complement component deficiencies (C1 through C9), so it is a Disease Class. The bare word 'deficiency' alone is excluded, but the compound refers to a category of diseases.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 1 (Disease Class); Examples 10-11 (family-of-diseases terms); What NOT to Annotate 4 (general terms)

decisions.rationale: Second mention of myasthenia gravis in the same sentence group; duplicate mentions must each be annotated, and it is the same specific disease.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 4 (Annotate duplicate mentions); What to Annotate 1 (Specific Disease)

decisions.rationale: 'MG' is the standard abbreviation defining myasthenia gravis in parentheses. Abbreviation and long form are annotated as separate mentions, so the short form is its own Specific Disease mention.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 6 (Synonymous mentions / abbreviation definitions); What to Annotate 1 (Specific Disease)

decisions.rationale: 'MG' in 'typical MG' is a repeated abbreviation referring to myasthenia gravis, a specific disease, and duplicates are annotated.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 4 (Annotate duplicate mentions); What to Annotate 6 (Synonymous mentions)

decisions.rationale: 'C2 deficiency' in 'heterozygous C2 deficiency' names the same specific disease as C2-deficiency, a single well-defined complement deficiency, and is annotated as a duplicate mention.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 1 (Specific Disease); What to Annotate 4 (Annotate duplicate mentions)
